title: On the Alzer-Berg problem: an optimal Bernstein boundary and a uniqueness conjecture
summary: We study the two-parameter exponential family associated with the complete-monotonicity problem of Alzer and Berg. Strict necessary parameter bounds place every possible Bernstein function in the domain of a regularized Laplace representation. A quantitative positivity-transfer inequality then yields a linear sufficient condition with the largest possible universal coefficient, expressed in terms of the exact one-parameter critical exponent.
